notes: Coach traits: at levels 2 and 4 of each track (Recruiter, Developer, Big-game, Media) you choose one of two permanent traits. Closer or Road warrior; Living room legend or Pipeline; Position coach (pick a group to develop faster) or Camp culture; Iron man program or Next level; Rivalry fuel or Road dog; Fourth-quarter closer or Primetime; Spin doctor or Fan favorite; Insider or Booster whisperer. The choice shows up on Home when you earn it and your traits live on the Program tab.
